phases.objective: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Foundation: Add 'role' to ValidateProps.user in api-lib/constants.js. Update insertUser in api-lib/db/user.js to default to 'citizen' and expose role in dbProjectionUsers().

Geospatial Data Structures & Validation: Replace ValidateProps.post with ValidateProps.alert in api-lib/constants.js containing status, species, breed, description, contactInfo, location (GeoJSON Point), and photos (Base64 array).

Database Layer Transformation: Create api-lib/db/alert.js with geospatial query findAlerts using $geoNear, insertAlert, and deleteAlertById with cascading deletes to comments. Delete api-lib/db/post.js and update api-lib/db/index.js to export alert.

API Routes & Dependency Updates: Create pages/api/alerts/index.js and pages/api/alerts/[alertId]/index.js. Delete pages/api/posts. Update api-lib/db/comment.js to use alertId. Move comment routes to pages/api/alerts/[alertId]/comments and update validation. Update api-lib/db/user.js deleteUserById to cascade delete alerts.
